question: About how many students attended the average US public elementary school in the 2021-22 school year?
In a 2025 national survey of US churches, how many people came to regular worship at the median church (the middle one, with half bigger and half smaller)?
On average, how many miles did a semi truck (tractor-trailer) registered in the US drive in 2024?
How many Connecticuts would fit inside Alaska?
The Pacific Ocean covers about how many times as much area as the United States?
California has about how many times as many people as Wyoming?
The first US census was taken in 1790. The 2020 census counted about how many times as many people?
How many Earths would it take to weigh as much as Jupiter, the largest planet?
How many Earths would it take to weigh as much as the Sun?
About how many Earths would fit side by side in the gap between the Earth and the Moon?
The Sun is about how many times farther from the Earth than the Moon is?
Pluto is on average about how many times farther from the Sun than the Earth is?
How many marathons would you have to run to go once around the Earth at the equator?
Lake Superior holds about how many times as much water as Lake Erie?
A bucket of water weighs about how many times as much as the air that fills the same bucket at sea level?
The Smithsonian's National Zoo says a newborn giant panda is about the size of a stick of butter. By its figure, the mother is about how many times bigger?
An American football field, counting the end zones, has about how many times the area of an NBA basketball court?
A spacecraft in low orbit around the Earth travels at about how many times the speed of sound (in air at ground level)?
How many home runs were hit in the whole 2026 Major League Baseball regular season, adding up all 30 teams?
How many times was a batter hit by a pitch in the whole 2026 Major League Baseball regular season?
In an average Major League Baseball game in 2025, how many times did one team's batters come up to bat?
When a Major League Baseball batter hits the ball, about how fast in miles per hour does it come off the bat, on average?
How many three-point shots did one team attempt in an average NBA game in the 2025-26 season?
How many rebounds did one team grab in an average NBA game in the 2025-26 season?
About how many seconds does the winning horse take to run the Kentucky Derby, a race of one and a quarter miles?
About how many minutes did the winner take to run the men's 10,000 meters (about 6.2 miles) at the 2024 Olympics?
About how many yards does an average drive travel on the PGA Tour (the top men's golf tour)?
Interstate 5 runs up the West Coast from the Mexican border at San Diego to the Canadian border north of Seattle. How many miles long is that drive?
About how many miles is the drive from Key West, Florida to the far northwest tip of Washington State, the two points in the lower 48 states that are farthest apart by road?
How many miles is it from New York to London by the shortest route a plane can fly?
In 2018 the Australian airline Qantas began flying nonstop from Perth, Australia to London. About how many hours does the flight take?

In 1935 an airline began carrying passengers from London to Brisbane, Australia, in small planes that landed dozens of times along the way (with one stretch by overnight train). How many days did the trip take?
How many miles long is the Trans-Siberian Railway, the train line across Russia from Moscow to the Pacific coast?
How many miles long is the train line from Boston to Washington, DC, which passes through New York and Philadelphia?
About how many minutes does the fastest bullet train take to go from Tokyo to Osaka, a trip of about 320 miles?
In 1876 a special express train raced from New York to San Francisco to show how fast the new railroad was. About how many hours did the trip take?
Ships from the Atlantic Ocean can sail up the St. Lawrence River and through the Great Lakes all the way to Duluth, Minnesota, at the far end of Lake Superior. How many miles is that trip?
Bermuda is an island out in the Atlantic Ocean. About how many miles is it from the nearest land, the coast of North Carolina?
Easter Island, the Pacific island with the giant stone heads, belongs to Chile. How many miles is it from the coast of Chile?
The northernmost town in the United States is on the north coast of Alaska. About how many miles is it from there to the North Pole?
What is the greatest distance from north to south across the lower 48 states, in miles?
In 1935 a flying boat carried the first airmail across the Pacific, from San Francisco to the Philippines, stopping at islands along the way. About how many hours did it spend in the air?
In 2025, how many minutes a day did Americans aged 15 and older spend watching TV on average, counting those who watched none?
In 2025, on days when Americans aged 15 and older did any sports, exercise or active recreation, how many minutes did they spend on it on average?

In 2025, how many minutes a day did American adults (18 and older) living in a home with a child under 6 spend directly caring for the children (feeding, bathing, playing with them) on average, counting adults who did none that day?
In 2025, how many minutes a day did Americans aged 15 to 19 spend playing games (video games and others) and using a computer for fun on average, counting those who did none?
Among Americans aged 16 and older who did volunteer work for an organization, what was the median number of hours they volunteered over a year? (Figure for the year ending September 2015.)
A 2019 study measured almost 50,000 sermons that US churches posted online. How many minutes long was the median sermon?
On average, how many hours a year did a worker in Germany work in 2022?
On average, about how many hours a week do employees in the US leisure and hospitality industry (restaurants, hotels, amusement parks and the like) work, counting part-timers? (2026)
On average, how many students are there for every one school counselor in US public schools (2024-25 school year)?
On average, how many hours a week do full-time US public school teachers spend on teaching and all other school work, counting work done outside school hours (2020-21 school year)?
In US public elementary schools where one teacher has the same class all day, how many students were in the average class in the 2017-18 school year?
In the Physicians Foundation's 2018 survey of about 8,800 US doctors of all kinds, how many patients did they say they see per day on average?
On average, how many prescriptions did one independent (non-chain) US pharmacy fill in the whole of 2023?
According to the American Farm Bureau, how many people does one US farm feed for a year on average, counting people in the US and abroad?
In 1776 the economist Adam Smith described a small pin factory where ten workers each did one step of the job. By his count, how many pins a day did they make per worker?
Recruits in the ancient Roman army first had to manage a march at the regular pace, carrying a 45-pound pack for about five to six hours. How many miles (in today's miles) did they have to cover?
How many dollars of play money come in a standard US Monopoly set (the sets sold since 2008)?
If you straightened out the coiled wire that glows inside an old-style 60-watt light bulb, about how many inches long would it be?
On average, how many cranberries go into one can of jellied cranberry sauce?
About how many cherries grow on an average tart cherry tree (the kind grown for pies) in a year?
How many ridges are crimped around the edge of the metal cap on a glass bottle of soda or beer?
How many black bars are in the standard barcode printed on groceries in US stores (the kind with 12 digits under it)?
The Cairo-Cape Town Highway is a road route running the length of Africa, from Cairo in Egypt to Cape Town in South Africa. How many miles long is it?
The Philippines is a country in Southeast Asia made up entirely of islands. How many islands does it have?
India holds the biggest elections in the world. How many people voted in its 2024 national election?
India has more post offices than any other country. About how many does it have?
Most people in India still live in the countryside. How many villages did India's 2011 census count?
About how many tigers live in the wild in India, the country with the most of them?
About how many elephants live in the wild in the whole of Africa?
In Peru, roasted guinea pig is a traditional dish. About how many guinea pigs do Peruvians eat in a year?
Most people in Vietnam, a country of about 100 million, get around by motorbike. About how many motorbikes and mopeds were registered there in 2025?
People in China (counting Hong Kong) eat more instant noodles than any other country. About how many billion servings do they eat in a year?
About how many students take China's national college entrance exam each year?
Thailand is a mostly Buddhist country. About how many Buddhist temples does it have?
Bangladesh (a country next to India) sews a large share of the world's clothes. About how many people work in its clothing factories?
Because new cars could hardly be brought into Cuba for decades, people there still drive American cars from the 1950s. About how many of these old American cars are on Cuba's roads?
Colombia (in South America) is famous for its coffee, most of it grown on small family farms. About how many families grow coffee there?
Machu Picchu is the ancient Inca city in the mountains of Peru. About how many people visit it in a year?
Nigeria's film industry, known as Nollywood, makes low-budget movies very quickly. About how many feature films did it make in 2020?
Mongolia, the land of Genghis Khan between Russia and China, has about 3.5 million people, many of them herders. About how many horses did it have at the end of 2023?
In South Africa, millions of commuters ride to work in privately owned minibus taxis. How many minibuses were registered in the country in 2021?
Tuk-tuks are the little three-wheeled taxis of Thailand. About how many were registered as taxis across the country in 2017?
Worldwide in 2018-2022, the odds of dying on any one airline flight you boarded were 1 in how many?
Based on 2023 deaths, the lifetime odds of a US resident dying in a motor vehicle crash of any kind (driver, passenger, motorcyclist or pedestrian) are 1 in how many?
Based on 2023 deaths, the lifetime odds of a US resident being killed by a dog are 1 in how many?
A physics study worked out the odds that a tossed US nickel lands and stays on its edge. They are about 1 in how many?
Tortoiseshell cats (patched black and orange) are almost always female. About 1 in how many is a male?
In the US, about 1 in how many people has AB-negative blood, the rarest of the eight main blood types?
About 1 in how many men is color blind?
In the US, about 1 in how many people has albinism (little or no pigment in the skin, hair and eyes)?
State Farm estimates that from July 2025 to June 2026, 1 in how many US drivers hit an animal badly enough to make an insurance claim?
About 1 in how many boys who play high school basketball in the US goes on to play on an NCAA college team?
How many seats are on one of Japan's 16-car bullet trains?
How many cubic yards of concrete does an ordinary concrete mixer truck carry?
How many barrels of oil can a typical supertanker (the largest common size of oil ship) carry?
In World War II, American soldiers landed on enemy beaches in small flat-bottomed boats with a ramp at the front (Higgins boats). How many soldiers did one boat carry?
How many pounds of mail and packages is a US Postal Service mail truck (the boxy white kind) built to carry?
How many passengers can one monorail train at Walt Disney World carry?
How many people does one glass capsule on the London Eye (the giant Ferris wheel in London) hold?
How many passengers does one Maid of the Mist tour boat carry to the foot of Niagara Falls?
How many square feet of indoor space does the average Home Depot store have?
What was the median size (the middle one), in square feet, of the new apartments finished in the US in 2025 that were built to be rented?
What was the median lot size (the middle one), in square feet, of the new single-family detached houses sold in the US in 2025? The lot is the land the house sits on.
How many square feet is the floor of the Main Concourse at Grand Central Terminal in New York, the big hall with the clock in the middle?
How many acres does Arlington National Cemetery, the military cemetery near Washington, DC, cover?
How many acres do the Taj Mahal and its walled gardens in India cover?
How many acres of land does Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) cover?
How many acres does Churchill Downs, the horse racing track that hosts the Kentucky Derby, cover?
A baby red kangaroo is born tiny and grows up in its mother's pouch. About how many days old is it when it leaves the pouch for the last time?

A harp seal pup (the fluffy white baby seal of the Arctic) weighs about 25 pounds at birth, and its mother feeds it rich milk for only about 12 days. About how many pounds does the pup weigh when she stops?
On average, about how many days does a red blood cell last in a healthy person's bloodstream before the body replaces it?
On average, how many days does a rice plant take to grow from planting until it is ready to harvest on a US farm?
Lake Superior holds so much water, and so little flows out, that a drop of water stays in the lake a long time. On average, how many years does it stay?
If death rates stayed as they were in 2022, how many out of every 100,000 babies born in the US would live to age 100?
In 2023, how many more years could a 65-year-old in the US expect to live, on average?
What was the average (mean) age of US women giving birth to their first child in 2024?
In the US, what is the median age (the middle one) at which people are told they have cancer?
In a US health survey from 2017 to early 2020, how many natural teeth did people aged 65 and older have left on average, counting only people who still had at least one tooth?
According to the CDC, about how many extra calories a day does a pregnant woman need during the middle three months of her pregnancy?
A sleeping adult goes round and round through light sleep, deep sleep and dreaming. How many minutes does one of these cycles last on average?
About how many people in the world were still not using the internet in 2025?
About how many people around the world drown each year?
About how many babies in the world were born too early (more than three weeks before their due date) in 2020?
By the World Health Organization's count, about how many people in the world used tobacco (cigarettes, chewing tobacco and the like) in 2024?
By the United Nations' count, about how many people in the world went hungry (did not get enough food) in 2024?
About how many people in the world live in a country other than the one they were born in (as of 2024)?
About how many adults in the world (ages 15 and older) cannot read and write?
About how many people in the world live more than 8,200 feet above sea level?
By a 2021 estimate, about how many people in the world speak English as their first language?
About how many people in the world worked in agriculture in 2022?
By the World Health Organization's count, about how many blood donations were collected around the world in 2023?
About how many people in the world were living with dementia (such as Alzheimer's disease) in 2021?
By the World Health Organization's count, about how many adults (18 and older) in the world were obese in 2024?
About how many people in the world were living with HIV (the virus that causes AIDS) at the end of 2025?
By the United Nations' count, about how many people in the world had been forced from their homes by war, violence or persecution at the end of 2024?
By the World Health Organization's estimate, about how many people in the world need a wheelchair?
How many legs does a full-grown house centipede (the long-legged kind that runs across basement walls) have?
How fast does a large dragonfly normally cruise, in miles per hour?
Lyme disease is spread by tick bites. By the CDC's estimate, about how many people in the US are treated for it each year?
About how many people in the US report being bitten by a black widow spider each year?
In a warm room (about 77°F), about how many days does a fruit fly live, counting from the egg to its death?
How many legs does a pill bug (roly-poly) have?
Without using its wings, a large grasshopper can jump about how many times its own body length?
The cicadas that come out of the ground every 17 years wait until the soil about 8 inches down has warmed up. How warm does it have to be, in °F?
The red food coloring called carmine or cochineal is made from dried, crushed insects that live on cactus. About how many insects does it take to make one pound of the dye?
About how many pest control worker (exterminator) jobs were there in the US in 2025?

In 1787 the First Fleet, a group of 11 British ships, set sail to start the first European settlement in Australia. About how many people were on board, counting convicts, marines, sailors and officials?
HMS Victory was a big wooden British warship of the late 1700s with over 100 cannons. How many men were in its crew when it was fully manned?
The Rosetta Stone, the carved slab in the British Museum that let scholars read Egyptian hieroglyphs, is nearly 4 feet tall. How many pounds does it weigh?
The Bayeux Tapestry is a strip of embroidered cloth about 20 inches tall that tells the story of the Norman conquest of England in 1066. How many feet long is it?
Hadrian's Wall was built by the Romans from coast to coast across the north of England. How many miles long was it?
Hadrian's Wall was built by the Romans from coast to coast across the north of England. About how many Roman soldiers were stationed along it when it was fully manned?
Machu Picchu is the ancient Inca city on a mountain ridge in Peru. About how many people lived there when it was in use?
About how many people lived in London around 1600, when Shakespeare was writing his plays?
The Roman army was organized into legions. About how many soldiers were in one legion at full strength in the time of the emperors?
For about 80 years, until 1868, Britain shipped convicted criminals to Australia as a punishment. About how many convicts were sent in all?
In the Battle of Britain in 1940, the Royal Air Force fought off the German air force over England. How many pilots and aircrew flew for the British side?

In the nine months before World War II, the Kindertransport trains and boats carried children, most of them Jewish, out of Nazi Germany and nearby countries to safety in Britain without their parents. About how many children were rescued this way?
The Domesday Book was a survey ordered by William the Conqueror in the 1080s, listing who owned what in the towns and villages across most of England. How many places does it name?
In the Gunpowder Plot of 1605, Guy Fawkes was caught in a cellar under England's Parliament guarding the gunpowder meant to blow it up. How many barrels of gunpowder were there?
Bletchley Park was Britain's secret code-breaking center in World War II, where German messages were cracked. How many people worked for it at its busiest, in January 1945?
Pripyat was the city built for the workers of the Chernobyl nuclear power plant in the Soviet Union. How many people lived there when it was emptied the day after the 1986 accident?
About how many soldiers did Napoleon have in his army at the Battle of Waterloo in 1815, his final defeat?
Stephenson's Rocket, built in England in 1829, was the most famous of the early steam locomotives. What was its top speed in miles per hour?
